sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Your vision today will have a hue of green as you will draw to money like a fly to sweets. Taste the power of money with fortune as the monkey on your back. You may buy a pendant or a necklace today and your haggling skills will save you from being swindled, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Be a pioneer thinker today, Taurus. There's a noble courage in your thoughts, so don't let this quality go to waste. You will be surprised at how cutting edge you can be when you put your mind to it. Take a walk by yourself and contemplate the next major move that you'd like to make in your life. Feel free to brainstorm bold ways to execute this plan.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Get an early start to ensure the day moves smoothly, dearest Taurus. The Gemini Moon forms sweet aspects with the Libra Sun and Saturn this morning, putting you in a productive yet introspective mood. Having a few moments to yourself before entering busy environments will help you maintain focus and stamina as the hours pass. You'll also feel more at ease if you're not struggling to keep up with the clock. Home will be a welcome sight once evening sets in and Luna aligns with Jupiter.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Today you feel relaxed and in the right mood to enjoy. You should refrain from consuming alcohol or any such item today, as you may lose your items in toxic state. Try not to offend others and adapt to your family needs. This is a wonderful day to negotiate with new clients. Natives of this zodiac sign will get plenty of time for themselves today. You can use this time to fulfill your desires, read a book or listen to your favorite music. You and your spouse will create the best memory of your married life today.

readings.text: You are likely to be very self-centered. You will stick to your principles at the workplace. This inflexibility may be understood as stubbornness by others and it may compromise your reputation. Try to be flexible, suggests Ganesha.

Your physical energy becomes sluggish today, and unfortunately, this trend will continue through the next few months. There will be times when you are feeling strong, but overall, you may feel as if you are trying to run with a ball and chain on.

Ganesha feels that this is the right time to think about putting a sum aside in some fixed deposit schemes or in something that gives you regular returns. You will not be in mood to take financial risks.
You're a social butterfly capable of attracting just the right mix of business and pleasure into your life. Your pursuit of excellence in the mental arena is of primary importance.

Taste the power of money with fortune as the monkey on your back.

readings.text: Today you will realise the value of good health and work on those lines. You can spend more time at gym, or doing yoga or aerobics. You can challenge your own limits in exercising. You will feel good internally as you will not waste energy.

You need to remain open to the part of you that wants things to be "just so" and let it know when it's being too demanding! All you need to do is a little each day. A few glasses of water here, a short jog there, a salad or fresh vegetables on a daily basis. It's the negative self-image that becomes too much to bear.

bits.t: The Gemini Moon forms sweet aspects with the Libra Sun and Saturn this morning, putting you in a productive yet introspective mood.
Today you feel relaxed and in the right mood to enjoy.

lucky.remedy: Use spices (garam masala), dry fruits, jaggery every day in moderate quantities while preparing food for improving your financial status.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Move forward with plans -- don't wait for everyone to weigh in with their thoughts.
